title: liftlog
description: Forklift & aerial-lift compliance records for warehouses — read-only demo tools.
summary: Forklift & aerial-lift compliance records for warehouses — read-only demo tools.
offersHint: Forklift & aerial-lift compliance records for warehouses — read-only demo tools. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://liftlog.artificl.us/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_requirements
toolsPreview.description: Search lift compliance requirements by operator name, machine, or requirement type. Returns matching records with next due date and status.

toolsPreview.name: list_citable_items
toolsPreview.description: List overdue or missing compliance items — the ones that would be citable in an OSHA inspection or damaging in an injury investigation. Most serious first.

toolsPreview.name: get_requirements_due
toolsPreview.description: List operator evaluations, inspections, and maintenance intervals due within the next N days (default 30).

toolsPreview.name: get_lift_summary
toolsPreview.description: Get the lift compliance summary: totals for tracked requirements, not done, overdue and citable, due this week, and awaiting records.

toolsPreview.name: export_lift_log
toolsPreview.description: Export the full lift compliance log as CSV text (operator or machine, requirement, next due, status, chase history).
